info.title: Client Admin API Reference
info.description:
Authentication

Check API permissions use the /permissions/permitted-routes endpoint.

User Authentication

All endpoints require an access token issued by Okta. To have read-only access you must be part of an app.atlas.cat.* group.

Application Authentication

All endpoints require an API Key to be sent in the Authorization header with value in the format ApiKey XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX

Transformation - Client Admin Team - Website
